test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Through thick and thin

options.text: Always supporting someone even if there are problems or difficulties
Never giving up on a goal

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Through thick and thin"** means always supporting someone even if there are problems or difficulties. (हर परिस्थिति में) • **Example:** She has stood by me** through thick and thin**, and I am grateful for her unwavering support. • **Always supporting someone even if there are problems or difficulties** means being loyal and constant in any situation, regardless of the challenges. (हर परिस्थिति में समर्थन देना) • **Example:** True friends remain loyal through thick and thin, never abandoning each other. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Sometimes thin, sometimes thick** (कभी पतला, कभी मोटा): This phrase does not convey any specific idiomatic meaning. • **Example:** The phrase "sometimes thin, sometimes thick" is not commonly used and doesn't have a specific idiomatic meaning. • **Never giving up a friendship** (कभी दोस्ती नहीं छोड़ना): This implies a commitment to maintaining a friendship but doesn't fully capture the essence of the idiom. • **Example:** She believes in never giving up a friendship, no matter the circumstances. • **Never giving up on a goal** (कभी लक्ष्य नहीं छोड़ना): This suggests persistence towards a goal but doesn't relate to the idiom in question. • **Example:** He is determined and never gives up on a goal, no matter how challenging it is. 304:Td75, The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
